description: Creates a new Cognigy.AI handover provider for live agent escalation, based on one of the services from list_handover_services. The provider starts with the service's default properties; change them with update_handover_provider. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to create.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without creating. Set to false to actually create.

projectId.description: The project ID to create the handover provider in

type.description: Handover service name as returned by list_handover_services (e.g., 'liveAgent', 'salesforce', 'genesysCloud', 'chatwoot')

name: create_handover_provider
